_note: Red-flag symptom patterns for rag/risk.py. Demo coverage for a hackathon, not a validated clinical tool. Terms match the START of a word in the consult's English symptoms ('breathless' matches 'breathlessness'). A rule fires when every group in 'all' has a match. 'any' raises it to 'level'; without an 'any' match it fires at 'else_level', or not at all if there is none. 'history' raises it to history.level when the patient's safety facts or retrieved records mention a term. Measured temperature >= 38 C counts as the symptom 'fever'.

rules.title: Possible heart attack
rules.action: Emergency: ECG now if available, keep the patient at rest, and arrange hospital transfer unless a heart attack is ruled out.

rules.title: Possible stroke
rules.action: Emergency: note the time the symptoms started and transfer to a hospital with a stroke unit now.

rules.title: Possible bleed in the brain
rules.action: Emergency: a sudden, severe headache needs hospital assessment now.

rules.title: Possible severe allergic reaction (anaphylaxis)
rules.action: Emergency: follow the clinic's anaphylaxis protocol and arrange transfer.

rules.title: Severe breathing difficulty
rules.action: Emergency: check oxygen saturation now and arrange transfer.

rules.title: Breathlessness
rules.action: Check oxygen saturation and breathing rate (they drive the NEWS2 score).

rules.title: Possible bleeding from the gut
rules.action: Urgent: check pulse and blood pressure, and arrange same-day hospital assessment.

rules.title: Head injury
rules.action: Watch for drowsiness, vomiting or a worsening headache. A head injury on a blood thinner needs a CT scan.

rules.title: Risk of self-harm
rules.action: Do not leave the patient alone. Urgent mental health assessment today.

rules.title: Seizure
rules.action: Urgent: check blood sugar. A first or prolonged seizure needs hospital assessment.

rules.title: Fainting
rules.action: Check pulse, blood pressure and blood sugar, and an ECG if available.

rules.title: Coughing blood
rules.action: Urgent: same-day assessment with a chest X-ray.

rules.title: Possible tuberculosis
rules.action: Sputum test for TB and a chest X-ray, as per the national TB programme.

rules.title: Possible high blood sugar (diabetes)

history.reason: Earlier blood sugar result on record

rules.action: Check blood glucose now, and HbA1c.

rules.title: Weight loss
rules.action: Ask whether it is intended. If not, compare with earlier weights and look for a cause (diabetes, thyroid, TB).
